Prophecy: Peter, Sifted by Satan, Shall Return and Strengthen His Brethren
ProphecySummary: Jesus predicts that Satan has desired to sift Peter as wheat, but that he has prayed for Peter's faith not to fail, and that when Peter is converted (turned back) he shall strengthen his brethren.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled: Peter denied Christ, was restored after the resurrection (John 21:15-17), and strengthened his brethren as a leading witness in Acts.
